body.objective: Promote the certified full connection Smith type (0,0,2) at the enclosed axial spin-two QNM to a rigorously scoped second-order pole theorem for an analytic Fredholm realization of the repeated spin-two differential block.
body.stop_condition: Choose a hyperboloidal compactification or exterior-complex-scaled scalar Regge-Wheeler QNM space with a fixed domain D and target Y. Prove that L(omega):D->Y is an analytic Fredholm family of index zero on the certified local disk and that the rational extension E(omega):D->Y is analytic and graph-norm bounded. Construct the triangular parametrix for the repeated block, import the certified nonzero connection selector and spin-one local-unit certificate by hash, and either prove the rank-one second-order Laurent principal part or emit the first exact domain/boundedness obstruction. State the inverse-transform t exp(i omega_n t) consequence only for sources with nonzero adjoint projection and only within the established Fredholm evolution convention.
body.current_gate: Analytic scalar QNM Fredholm domain and graph-norm boundedness of the intrinsic extension on the certified local disk
body.forbid: no connection EP2 called a Green-resolvent pole before the Fredholm domain is proved; no formal outgoing endpoint condition called a closed operator domain; no unregulated divergent QNM overlap; no one-pole result called time-domain stability, completeness or an all-overtone theorem; no particle, ghost, CPT or quantum-unitarity promotion
activates: a genuine second-order axial Bach Green-resolvent pole theorem at the certified QNM
a generalized damped ringdown term for generically coupled sources in the declared Fredholm realization
body.resource_hint: The repeated block needs no independent six-state Fredholm construction. A scalar parametrix S gives the triangular parametrix [[S,-S E S],[0,S]], and the certified nonzero selector supplies the double-pole coefficient after the analytic domain hypotheses are closed.
notes: Mathematical target: an analytic Fredholm pencil with a rank-one order-two Laurent coefficient.
Counterexample strategy: fail on the first endpoint-domain, compactness, graph-boundedness, or analytic-family defect rather than importing a formal connection argument.
The connection-level EP2 is already certified and remains valid if this promotion shortfalls.
